label.description: Navigation label for a group of child pages without an authored page body.
label.markdownDescription:
```yaml
label: Guides
```

The category label shown in global navigation, tree navigation, mobile navigation, and breadcrumbs.

[Navigation category reference (current)](https://janga.github.io/norna/reference/site/pages/#page-or-category)

[Norna 0.7.26 source reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.26/docs/pages.md#navigation-categories)

description: A navigation group without an authored page body. Opening its URL redirects when its first listed direct child is a page; otherwise it shows a generated child list.
title: Norna page category
markdownDescription:
```yaml
label: Guides
```

`category.yaml` groups child pages without editorial content. Its URL opens the first listed direct page, or a generated child list when the first child is a category.

[Navigation category reference (current)](https://janga.github.io/norna/reference/site/pages/#page-or-category)

[Norna 0.7.26 source reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.26/docs/pages.md#navigation-categories)
